metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in California higher than in Mississippi during July 12-19, 2005?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS LST daily Terra (MODIS/061/MOD11A1) filtered to 2005-07-12..2005-07-20 (end-exclusive) for California and Mississippi. If empty, fall back to Aqua daily (MYD11A1), then to 8-day Terra (MOD11A2), then 8-day Aqua (MYD11A2). If still empty, widen the dates by ±4 days once. 
2. Masking strategy: Use QC_Day bits 0-1 == 0 (good quality) and mask LST_Day_1km == 0. Convert LST to Celsius using scale 0.02 K. No cloud band; report valid pixel percentage (proxy for usable data).
3. Logic: Check collection size early (C1). After masking and averaging, count valid pixels; if zero for any state, C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range [-50, 80] C, C3. Otherwise compare means: A if California > Mississippi else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObject.evaluate(resolve, reject));
}

function maskLSTDayToC(img) {
  const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km');
  const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
  const good = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 == 0 -> good quality
  const valid = good.and(lst.neq(0));
  const lstC = lst.updateMask(valid).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LST_C');
  return lstC.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
}

function makeComposite(collectionId, start, end) {
  const col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId).filterDate(start, end).map(maskLSTDayToC);
  const img = col.mean().rename('LST_C');
  return { col, img };
}

async function chooseCollection(start, end) {
  const attempts = [
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1', label: 'Terra daily' },
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MYD11A1', label: 'Aqua daily' },
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2', label: 'Terra 8-day' },
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MYD11A2', label: 'Aqua 8-day' },
  ];
  for (const att of attempts) {
    const size = await getInfoAsync(ee.ImageCollection(att.id).filterDate(start, end).size());
    if (size && size > 0) return { id: att.id, label: att.label, size, start, end };
  }
  // Widen once by ±4 days if all above were empty
  const widenedStart = ee.Date(start).advance(-4, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd');
  const widenedEnd = ee.Date(end).advance(4, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd');
  const wStart = await getInfoAsync(widenedStart);
  const wEnd = await getInfoAsync(widenedEnd);
  for (const att of attempts) {
    const size = await getInfoAsync(ee.ImageCollection(att.id).filterDate(wStart, wEnd).size());
    if (size && size > 0) return { id: att.id, label: att.label + ' (±4d)', size, start: wStart, end: wEnd };
  }
  return null;
}

function stateGeometry(stateName) {
  const states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States');
  return states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', stateName)).first().geometry();
}

async function regionStats(img, geom, scale) {
  const reducers = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true });
  const stats = img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: reducers,
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    tileScale: 4
  });
  const constCount = ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    tileScale: 4
  });
  const s = await getInfoAsync(stats);
  const t = await getInfoAsync(constCount);
  const mean = s ? s['LST_C_mean'] : null;
  const validCount = s ? s['LST_C_count'] : null;
  const totalCount = t ? t['c'] : null;
  return { mean, validCount, totalCount };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const scale = 1000;
    const start = '2005-07-12';
    const end = '2005-07-20'; // end exclusive to include 2005-07-19
    const ca = stateGeometry('California');
    const ms = stateGeometry('Mississippi');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    const choice = await chooseCollection(start, end);
    if (!choice) {
      console.log('No images found in any collection/date attempt.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Dataset: ${choice.id} [${choice.label}], Images: ${choice.size}, Date: ${choice.start}..${choice.end}`);

    const composite = makeComposite(choice.id, choice.start, choice.end).img;

    // 3. Processing and pixel counts
    const caStats = await regionStats(composite, ca, scale);
    const msStats = await regionStats(composite, ms, scale);

    // 4. Validations
    const checks = [caStats, msStats];
    for (const s of checks) {
      if (s.totalCount === 0 || s.totalCount === null) {
        console.log('Total pixel count is zero or null.');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
      if (!s.validCount || s.validCount === 0) {
        console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      if (s.mean === null || isNaN(s.mean) || s.mean < -50 || s.mean > 80) {
        console.log('Mean LST invalid or out of plausible range.');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
    }

    const caValidPct = (100.0 * caStats.validCount / caStats.totalCount);
    const msValidPct = (100.0 * msStats.validCount / msStats.totalCount);

    // 5. Stats output (concise, <=20 lines)
    console.log(`CA mean LST (C): ${caStats.mean.toFixed(2)}, Valid px: ${caStats.validCount}/${caStats.totalCount} (${caValidPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`MS mean LST (C): ${msStats.mean.toFixed(2)}, Valid px: ${msStats.validCount}/${msStats.totalCount} (${msValidPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    if (caStats.mean > msStats.mean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
